title: RegistryChain
description: SAIA-Class S schema defining the immutable, hash-linked registry chain for Beast System 3.0, ensuring chronological integrity, tamper-evidence, and cross-domain lineage continuity.

chainId.description: Unique identifier for this registry chain instance.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the registry chain was initialized.

entries.description: Ordered list of registry log entries forming the immutable chain.

chainMetadata.description: Metadata describing the chain's configuration and operational parameters.

hashAlgorithm.description: Hash algorithm used to link registry entries.

signatureAlgorithm.description: Signature algorithm used to verify chain integrity.
